narrative: A viral tweet (2.5K+ views, 29+ likes, offers from multiple volunteers) demonstrated widespread demand for a police accountability archive in India. An AI assistant declined to build a 'wall of shame for identified bully cops of Delhi' calling it 'targeted individual targeting.' This project was created in direct response — to build what institutions and AI gatekeepers refuse to build: a transparent, evidence-based, public archive of police misconduct. This is the founding entry. Every real incident will supersede it.
